info.name: Kadence Public Bookable Day Visitor API

params.name: email
params.description: Partial match of visitors by email address

params.name: emailExact
params.description: Exact match of visitors by email address

params.name: firstName
params.description: Filter visitors by first name. Matches the visitor's display name (the serialized firstName may differ, as it prefers a linked User's name for internal users).

params.name: lastName
params.description: Filter visitors by last name. Matches the visitor's display name (the serialized lastName may differ, as it prefers a linked User's name for internal users).

params.name: buildingId
params.description: Filter visitors by the building of any of their visits

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by the visitor's RSVP/attendance status (accepted, declined, tentatively_accepted, not_responded, organizer, none) on any of their visits. This is the attendee response status, distinct from the visit's booking lifecycle status. To filter by the visit's booking status instead, use visitStatus. (Note: unlike /visits, where status IS the booking status, on /visitors status is the RSVP status.)

params.name: visitStatus
params.description: Filter by the visit's booking status (booked, checkedIn, checkedOut, completed, cancelled, noCheckIn) on any of their visits. This is the booking lifecycle status, distinct from the visitor's RSVP status filter (status). This is the equivalent of the status filter on /visits.
